productAuthorityDecision.recordedFrom: Direct project owner statement in project conversation; not a signed independent cooperative/legal authority approval
productAuthorityDecision.originalRuleFa: اطلاعات دفتر سهام مرجع اصلی هر تعاونی است. نقل‌وانتقال در دفتر سهام ثبت می‌شود و مرجع اصلی، نهایی و قانونی دفتر سهام خواهد بود. پلتفرم فقط فرایند را مدیریت می‌کند. نقل‌وانتقال و خریدوفروش سهام تنها پس از ثبت در دفتر سهام شرکت، در پلتفرم قطعی و قابل استناد شناخته می‌شود و بدون آن غیرقابل استناد تلقی خواهد شد.
productAuthorityDecision.scope: Each cooperative's own official share/transfer register is the ONLY legal source of ownership truth; platform is a workflow/orchestration and verified read-projection, not an independent legally authoritative register.
productAuthorityDecision.ownershipProjectionRule: CHILD07 reflects the cooperative's verified official register; no platform ledger, payment, trade match, signature, approval, settlement or request independently creates legal ownership.
productAuthorityDecision.preRegistrationState: Pending requests/trades may be tracked operationally, but MUST NOT be marked TRANSFERRED, OWNERSHIP_FINAL, LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE or credited to the acquirer as legally owned without verified official-register entry.
productAuthorityDecision.postRegistrationState: Record finality only from authenticated per-tenant register evidence issued or certified by the authorized register custodian; reconcile official entry, owner/account identities and quantities, event/version, effective date and share-class/issued-share conservation.
productAuthorityDecision.corrections: Discrepancy or cancellation after entry must follow official register correction/reversal evidence and new source sequence; never silently rewrite ownership in the platform.
productAuthorityDecision.failureMode: If official-register entry is absent, unverified, stale, mismatched, revoked, or custodian authorization is missing: legal finality and transferable credited shares remain BLOCKED; show pending/disputed status, not final ownership.
explicitlyUnresolved: Authenticate each cooperative's legal register custodian and evidence delivery/verification mechanism
Attest per-tenant opening share register and total issued shares, reconcile mismatches
